page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top. Below the last line, the gathering signature "a 3" at the left and the catchword at the right.

main_text.p: se se,merito gloriantur. Ea me ra-tio impulit, Amplisfimi Viri, ut jā vobis exercitationes hafce meas phyficas otii nostri,velut oblecta-menta,& quasi solatia confecrare. Nam præterquam quod vestris meritis a me debebantur, patroci-nium quoque vestrum sibi quo-dammodo pollicebantur,quod & vos pro solita,dudumq; perfpecta humanitate vestra benigne susce-pturos,ipse confido. Isthæc igitur grati animi mei veluti σύμβολα (dū graviora,melioraque moliri dabit Deus) æqui boniq; uti confulatis, precibus omnib. oro vos,& ob-testor. page.notes: The Greek word after "veluti" appears to be σύμβολα with an accent on the upsilon; the accent is uncertain. "melioraqúe" is read as "melioraque" with an acute over the u, which is not certain. The catchword's last letter is not clear. The reading "phyficas otii" has an i-shape uncertain (printed as "otij"). Running head read as NUNCUPATORIA with the printed V for capital U. Long s is rendered as s throughout. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
